data.long_meaning: Husn is an Arabic name that signifies beauty, goodness, and excellence. It is derived from the Quranic word 'husn', which means beauty and perfection. The name Husn carries the meaning “Beauty and goodness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Husn usually hope their child will grow to embody beauty and goodness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Husn is considered a reflection of Allah's beauty and perfection.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Husn total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
